definition: The derivative of the derivative, written $f''(x)$ or $\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}$, which measures how fast the gradient is changing.
Bending upwards like a cup on an interval: the gradient $f'(x)$ increases as $x$ increases there, as it does wherever $f''(x) > 0$.
Bending downwards like an upside-down cup on an interval: the gradient $f'(x)$ decreases as $x$ increases there, as it does wherever $f''(x) < 0$.
